comparisons.reason: The constructs differ even though the sources and 0/1/null rules are similar. Feature 0 requires a comment to first restate or steelman the OP's view in a more nuanced form and then refute it, so the redrafting is the core predicate. Feature 1 requires a comment to explicitly challenge an underlying assumption or premise of the OP's view, rather than only facts or the conclusion, and it does not require any restatement. A comment can challenge a premise without redrafting the view, and a comment can redraft and then refute the view without targeting a premise. Neither predicate subsumes the other.
